title: Uncertainty Identifies Difficult Samples Across Methods: A Multi-Task Study on a Heterogeneous Skin Lesion Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2608.14768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skin lesion classifiers can be confidently wrong on the cases that matter most, so knowing when a prediction should not be trusted is clinically as useful as the prediction. We study uncertainty quantification on a dataset pooled from many ISIC sources, with a shared backbone and two jointly learned heads: a binary malignant versus non-malignant head and a five-class diagnostic head. Five UQ methods (MC Dropout, DropConnect, Flipout, Deep Ensembles, DUQ) are compared on accuracy, calibration, uncertainty decomposition, and risk-coverage. Difficulty is largely method-agnostic: even methods with narrow entropy distributions rank the same samples as hard (per-sample entropy correlations of $0.54$ to $0.91$). The choice of method matters more for calibration and uncertainty decomposition, where Deep Ensembles is the clear winner, than for finding difficult cases. translated_title: 不确定性识别跨方法中的困难样本：一项关于异质性皮肤病变数据集的多任务研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14768v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：皮肤病变分类器在最关键的病例上可能自信地犯错，因此知道何时不应信任预测在临床上与预测本身同样有用。我们在一个汇集了多个ISIC来源的数据集上研究不确定性量化，使用共享骨干网络和两个联合学习的头部：一个二元恶性与非恶性头部和一个五类诊断头部。比较了五种不确定性量化方法（MC Dropout、DropConnect、Flipout、Deep Ensembles、DUQ）在准确性、校准、不确定性分解和风险覆盖方面的表现。困难程度在很大程度上与方法无关：即使熵分布狭窄的方法也将相同的样本排名为困难样本（每样本熵相关性为0.54至0.91）。方法的选择对校准和不确定性分解的影响更大，其中Deep Ensembles是明显的赢家，而对寻找困难病例的影响较小。排名也足够好，以至于将最不确定的病例推迟处理可以去除...
tldr: 本研究在异质性皮肤病变数据集上比较五种不确定性量化方法，发现困难样本的识别跨方法高度一致，但校准和不确定性分解上Deep Ensembles表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This study compares five uncertainty quantification methods on a heterogeneous skin lesion dataset, finding that difficult sample identification is largely method-agnostic, while Deep Ensembles excels in calibration and uncertainty decomposition.
